feature_description: Build /community/* routes covering jumuiya governance, network browse, and member-facing community pages. Closes sitemap gap from project_sitemap_architecture memory.
notes: E3 gate removed — Jumuiya leaders approved 4 Returns framing + circular peer-review
E4 moved to Wave 6 — no gate
E1-E2 consolidated into single Opus task at complexity 8
Wave 5 complete: A1+A2+A3+B1 all done on 2026-06-09
Wave 6 complete: all 11 tasks done on 2026-06-09

A1.summary: Postgres schema: profiles + learning_site_memberships tables, member_role enum, RLS policies, auto-profile trigger

A2.summary: Supabase Auth migration: AuthProvider, sign-in/sign-up pages, OAuth callback, middleware route guard, DashboardClient ported to Supabase

A3.summary: Member dashboard shell: avatar upload (Supabase Storage), role badge, site affiliations with pentangle groups, Wave 6 content placeholders

B1.summary: learning_sites table with pentangle_group + member_count + peer_review_chain_position; seed for 13 CSV sites; TypeScript type extended; pentangle assignments added to static data

B3.summary: /community browse: bento-grid hero (impact stats), 50/50 sticky-map + SiteCard layout, region filter tabs; MemberCard forked from SiteCard

B2.summary: 9-section community site profile page; FourReturnsDisplay with animated counters + SVG arc indicators + aria-labels; WCAG 2.1 AA gallery section

C1.summary: TrialAndError Sanity schema: 4 mandatory prompt fields, taxonomy tags, status workflow; GROQ queries: getContributionsBySite, getContributionsByMember, searchContributions

C3.summary: Filterable T&E feed (site/challenge/property rights/date sort); member profile pages; /community/trials global feed

A2-alt.summary: Server-side Supabase helpers (getServerUser, getServerProfile, requireServerAuth); RSC auth guard on dashboard; live Supabase data augmentation on site profile

C2.summary: 4-step T&E submission form with Liveblocks collaborative drafting (TeDraftRoomProvider, real-time field sync, presence bar); Liveblocks auth endpoint; Sanity draft creation API

D1.summary: forum_threads + forum_posts schema (liveblocks_room generated column, post_count trigger, coordinator RLS); thread list with ForumRoomProvider presence + new thread form

D2.summary: Thread view: post chain (2-level reply nesting), ComposeBox with typing presence, coordinator lock/pin/hide controls, ForumRoomProvider scoped to thread room

D3.summary: notifications table (type enum, RLS, thread_locked trigger); Liveblocks webhook handler → Supabase notifications; NotificationBell with unread count + realtime subscription

E1-E2.summary: peer_reviews + pentangle_groups tables (seeded 4 groups, coordinator RLS); governance page: explainer, RadialOrbitalTimeline chain visualization, coordinator review form with baseline checklist, 4 Returns display

E4.summary: getFourReturnsForSite: fetches baseline_locked row + latest submitted review, calculates (current/baseline)*100; getFourReturnsForSites; getNetworkFourReturnsAverages; wired into site profile page with baselinePending prop
